purpose: Treat invariant projections themselves as presentations and identify their meanings only after a shared normalized observable agrees.

choice_semantics.projection_choice_invariant: All observed invariant projections for one semantic subject map to one common normalized observable digest.
choice_semantics.projection_choice_invariance_held: At least one projection presentation is missing, held, or unavailable, with no observed normalized contradiction.
choice_semantics.projection_choice_invariance_obstructed: Observed projection presentations disagree after mapping to the same normalized observable.
